title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II

trophies.name: Crocodile
trophies.desc: Shoot three enemies while underwater in 'Wetwork'.

trophies.name: Must be Wind
trophies.desc: Rescue the hostages in 'Countdown' without the enemies firing their weapons.

trophies.name: Gunless
trophies.desc: Finish 'Alone' without firing a gun.

trophies.name: Test Drive
trophies.desc: Drive five vehicle types in 'Violence and Timing'.

trophies.name: Ghost-in-Training
trophies.desc: Reach the penthouse in 'El Sin Nombre' without killing anyone or triggering the alarm.

trophies.name: Don’t touch the deck!
trophies.desc: In 'Dark Water' advance 90 meters towards the front of the ship without touching the deck.

trophies.name: Keeping this One
trophies.desc: Reach Price using the first vehicle you hijack.

trophies.name: Gentleman Thief
trophies.desc: Open three safes in the Campaign.

trophies.name: Wall of Duty
trophies.desc: Kill three Enemies with the Riot Shield in the Campaign or in Co-op.

trophies.name: Daredevil
trophies.desc: While affected by one Flashbang, kill two enemies in the Campaign or in Co-op.

trophies.name: Practice makes Perfect
trophies.desc: Shoot all the targets in the training area in 'Ghost Team'.

trophies.name: A Crappy Way to Die
trophies.desc: Kill the enemy in the porta-potty.

trophies.name: Nessie
trophies.desc: Reach the barge without being seen in 'Wetwork'.

trophies.name: No time to lose
trophies.desc: Complete the CCTV sequence in four minutes.

trophies.name: Backpack Guy
trophies.desc: Kill gassed or blinded enemies using a Molotov, Semtex and Frag in 'Prison Break'.

trophies.name: Cutting Heads off Snakes
trophies.desc: Finish all Campaign missions on Veteran or Realism difficulty.

trophies.name: Time for Pints
trophies.desc: Finish the Campaign on any difficulty.

trophies.name: Nobody was There
trophies.desc: Never trigger the alarm in 'Recon by Fire'.

trophies.name: Night Fight
trophies.desc: Earn three Stars in 'Low Profile'.

trophies.name: Hellride
trophies.desc: Earn three Stars in 'Denied Area'.

trophies.name: Kings of the Mountain
trophies.desc: Earn three Stars in 'Defender: Mt. Zaya'.

trophies.name: Going Dark
trophies.desc: Complete 'Low Profile' without triggering any alarms.

trophies.name: Only the Beginning
trophies.desc: Earn at least one Star in Co-op.

trophies.name: Full SSE
trophies.desc: Find 20 intel fragments in Co-op.
